$comment: U3 board half, plus the mounting holes.
R49 (10k NRST pull-up) came across from the schematic sync parked at
(1.52,0.74), off the board, because the placement dialog was escaped. It goes
into the reset cluster ~8 mm north of C46, at a point measured clear by
3.87 mm. NRST runs to SW6.1's stub at (77.20,128.50); +3V3 meets the long
diagonal feed at (77.55,119.20), which is the foot of the perpendicular from
the pad, so the tap is as short as that trace allows.
The four mounting holes are tied to GND. They are Pad_e672/673/674/675:
single PTH pads, 3.2 mm drill (M3) with a 5 mm annulus, at the board's
corners -- and until now on NO net, so each was an isolated 5 mm copper
island that would take whatever potential its standoff gave it. On a board
going into a metal chassis that is worth deciding rather than inheriting.
Caveat worth knowing: these footprints have no schematic symbol, so nothing
upstream asserts their net -- it lives in the board file alone. The sync
leaves them be (verified), but a future 'Update PCB from Schematic' run with
'delete footprints with no symbols' ticked would remove the holes outright,
which is a bigger problem than the net. The durable fix is mounting-hole
